About Us 
Jar is India’s leading Daily Saving app that helps people build strong saving habits—one small step at a time. Our goal is to make saving simple, rewarding, and truly life-changing. Founded in 2021 by Misbah Ashraf and Nishchay AG, Jar is a Bengaluru-based startup with one simple belief: saving a little every day in 24K Digital Gold can truly transform your future.  
Today, 20 million+ Indians trust Jar as their saving partner. With flexible saving options—Daily, Weekly, Monthly, and Instant Saving—we have made it easy for everyone to save in their own way and withdraw anytime. We are one of the leaders in UPI autopay transactions, crossing more than 1 million transactions per day. In 2023, we expanded our vision with Nek, our jewelry brand crafted to bring together luxury and affordability, it has since surpassed ₹100 crore in revenue.   
We have a big dream of bringing “Har Ghar Sona”. Small, consistent savings are just the start. We’re here to walk alongside our users, helping Indians secure their financial future every step of the way.  
Backed by Tiger Global Management, Arkam Ventures, and WEH Ventures, among others, we have raised $50 million+ in funding. In January 2025, we hit a huge milestone of becoming profitable. Now, we’re charging ahead, focused on sustainable growth and scaling impact.
And this is just the beginning!
 
What’s the role?  
As an Associate Product Manager at Nek by Jar, you will own the platform and internal systems that power Nek’s day-to-day operations. This includes our internal Order Management / CRM tools and key third-party integrations such as Unicommerce, Shiprocket, Delhivery, and other operational partners.
You will work closely with Engineering, Operations, Customer Support, Data, and external partners to improve these systems, resolve gaps, and support new product initiatives. You will also be expected to build a strong understanding of Nek’s overall architecture, services, integrations, and data flows so that you can evaluate the impact of new features across the platform.
 
What will be your responsibilities?
 
• Platform & Internal Tools
• Own Nek’s internal Order Management / CRM platform and other operational tools used by Customer Support and Operations teams.
• Identify product and process gaps and drive improvements that make internal systems more reliable, scalable, and efficient.
• Understand the end-to-end order lifecycle across inventory, payments, logistics, communication, and post-order journeys.
• Integrations & Architecture
• Act as the Product POC for integrations such as Unicommerce, Shiprocket, Delhivery, and other logistics or operational partners.
• Own integration requirements, feature enablement, partner coordination, and issue resolution.
• Develop a working understanding of APIs, services, dependencies, data flows, failure scenarios, and reconciliation across the platform.
• Evaluate and onboard new third-party platforms as business requirements evolve. 
• Data & Experimentation
• Use product and operational data to identify problems, validate hypotheses, and prioritise opportunities.
• Analyse funnels, user behaviour, operational metrics, and feature performance using tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, SQL, and dashboards.
• Design and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, define success metrics, and recommend whether initiatives should be scaled, iterated, or stopped. 
• Execution
• Work cross-functionally with Engineering, Operations, Customer Support, Data, Design, and Business teams to take initiatives from problem identification to launch.
• Translate business and operational problems into clear product requirements and scalable solutions.
• Monitor outcomes after launch and drive subsequent improvements. 
What’s required from you?
 
• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Math, Statistics, or a related discipline from a reputed institute.
• 1–3 years of experience in Product, Growth, Product Analytics, or a similar role in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
• Strong analytical skills and hands-on familiarity with tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, Clevertap, SQL, or similar platforms.
• Good understanding of A/B testing, funnels, metrics, and data-driven product decision-making.
• Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to prioritise effectively and work across multiple teams in a fast-paced environment.
• Prior experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, D2C, or order/logistics-heavy products is preferred. 
What do we stand for? 
 
The five values that we live by : 
Passion: At Jar, we strive to create an environment where people love what they do, are motivated and equipped to do their best work. 
Equality: We bring diverse skills, ideas, and experiences to the table, supporting and challenging each other across teams to create something bigger than ourselves. 
Growth: When our people grow, Jar grows. We create opportunities for learning, development, and meaningful impact. 
Accountability: The core of our work ethic is taking ownership of our work, showing initiative, and having the freedom to ask questions. 
Consistency: We believe in doing the right things consistently. Big change doesn’t happen overnight, it’s built one step at a time. 
Join us and let’s build something amazing together!   

What employee benefits do we have? 
Glad you asked! Among other things, we have 
• Medical Insurance for employees and their families
• Employee Wellbeing Program
• ESOPs allocation
• Pluxee meal card
• Swish club card for exclusive employee discounts 
• Advance salary plans
• Relocation assistance
• L&D programmes

SLSQ427R399

Databricks operates at the leading edge of the Data and AI space with a mission to help companies solve the world's toughest problems.

We are seeking an experienced strategic sales leader to lead our Bangalore based Business Development teams and help us expand our business across the India region.

Reporting to the Director, Sales Development, you will be an important contributor to our sales leadership team, building and executing pipeline generation / consumption growth strategies, while coaching and developing our Business Development team members.

You will have experience driving pipeline generation leveraging AI, leading sales development teams and working with sales, a partner ecosystem and marketing teams.

The impact you will have:

  • Take the primary leadership role in developing an outstanding team
  • Support and shape the strategy for pipeline generation within India in collaboration with the India Leadership team
  • Create innovative strategies to accelerate new customer acquisition and consumption growth 
  • Manage your team's pipeline target and be active in coaching team members to be successful
  • Work with cross - functional regional leaders to maximise the contribution of the team
  • Analyze team performance and funnel data to identify and fix inefficiencies
  • Adopt and implement AI strategy for pipe generation and daily workflows of your team

What we look for:

  • Minimum 3-4 years experience as a Sales Development manager with consistent overachievement against quota
  • Experience in a quota carrying, end to end sales role with consistent overachievement against quota
  • Experience in developing top talent
  • Experience in leading through change
  • Proficiency in using Salesforce and Outreach.io, additional experience with AI tools will be advantageous
  • Experienced in sales processes focused around value selling, prospecting and opportunity qualification
  • Ability to adapt to a fast paced environment 
  • Passion for cloud, big data and AI

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
